business_rules: Conflict detection is per-id, not per-payload-hash (renaming the draft is not a workaround).
Resolution belongs to the agent (rename + retry, or use /detect-sensors).
behavior.summary: Before writing, the script stats the target path; if present, it exits 1 with a stderr message naming the conflict. No file is overwritten.

description: Conflict variation: /create-sensor refuses to overwrite an existing sensor at <out>/.harness/sensors/<id>.json. This distinguishes /create-sensor (additive, single-shot) from /detect-sensors (which overwrites idempotently). The script exits non-zero and the agent is expected to ask the user for a different id or use /detect-sensors instead.

evidence.rationale: Pre-write existence check unique to create-sensor's variant of the persistence script.

expected_outcome.summary: Stderr explains the conflict; exit 1; the preexisting file is unchanged.

name: Refuse to create when a sensor with the same id already exists

trigger.summary: Skill invokes write-sensor.go on an id that already exists in the project tree.
